title: EU imposes 16% anti-dumping duty on Vietnam steel
dek: The European Union has imposed a 16% anti-dumping duty on steel from Vietnam, according to bne IntelliNews.
summary: According to bne IntelliNews, the EU has imposed a 16% anti-dumping duty on Vietnamese steel. The publisher's excerpt does not state which products are covered, the duration of the measure, or the companies affected.
keyFacts: The EU has imposed a 16% anti-dumping duty on Vietnam steel
whyItMatters: The measure adds to the EU's trade defence against Asian steel imports and could curb one of Vietnam's export outlets. Product scope, which the headline does not give, will determine the scale of the impact.
implications: Vietnamese exporters may redirect volumes to other markets, potentially adding pressure in Asia, including India; EU buyers could face reduced import options in the affected products.

related.title: EU applies anti-dumping duty on Vietnamese cold-rolled steel products
related.dek: The EU has applied an anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled steel products from Vietnam, the Vietnam Economic Times reports.
